precursor_access.finding: Mono-methyl bipyridinium iodide is prepared from commercial 4,4-dipyridyl and characterized by NMR

attachment.finding: The same precursor attaches to preformed crosslinked chloromethylated polystyrene in refluxing MeCN over 48 hours

selectivity.finding: The precursor has one remaining neutral pyridyl nitrogen; the other nitrogen is methyl-quaternized

retention.finding: Functionalized and counterion-exchanged beads retain viologen electroactivity; elemental-analysis conversion estimates are model-dependent

model_limit: The 4-methylbenzyl cap represents a local polymer site; the exact capped molecule is not the demonstrated support
